Based on my search, **Lucas Adams** currently plays Noah Newman on *The Young and the Restless*. He made his debut in the role on November 4, 2024, taking over from Rory Gibson, who had played the character from 2021 to 2023 before moving to *General Hospital* as Michael Corinthos.

Lucas Adams is best known to soap fans for his previous role as Tripp Dalton on *Days of Our Lives* (2017–2024), where he earned two Daytime Emmy nominations for Outstanding Younger Actor. Interestingly, this isn't his first time on *Y&R*—he made his television speaking debut back in 2012 in a brief one-day appearance as a character named Wesley.

Noah Newman is the eldest child of Nicholas Newman (Joshua Morrow) and Sharon Newman (Sharon Case), a legacy character who was born on-screen in 1997 and has been played by numerous actors over the years, including child actors, Kevin Schmidt, Luke Kleintank, and Robert Adamson.
